title: Single-owner bootstrap files: every shared bootstrap artifact has one owner
subject: single-owner-bootstrap-files
ratio: Every shared bootstrap or infra artifact an epic's tests or build will require - test package markers such as tests/__init__.py, fixtures directories, conftest-like scaffolding, build config - is enumerated in the epic plan and assigned to exactly ONE task as an explicit owned artifact, or to a dedicated bootstrap task that every consumer lists in depends_on, before any worker starts. No infra file may be left unowned across parallel sibling tasks; when two siblings would otherwise both need to create the same file, that is the signal to split out a bootstrap task, not to leave the file implicit. Reach, stated exactly: this rule binds plan-drafting protocol - the orchestration-planner and any coordinator or thinker acting as planner - and its home is the Bootstrap/infra ownership checklist rule in the planner's agent-definition file (.claude/agents/orchestration-planner.md, Decomposition rules). The per-epic Bootstrap / infra ownership table in .harness/plan.md is where the rule is applied, not a second home of the duty. It was never generalized into an all-agents ORCHESTRATION.md rule, and this record does not widen it: its reach is deliberately narrower than that of the verifier-rotation rule born of the same audit (F6, already codified as PR-004), which did reach ORCHESTRATION.md and the registry. Reach and authority tier are different axes and this record claims only the first: the tier states how well the norm is evidenced, never how far it binds.
